title: Text Input: Search input with icon (daisyUI)
notes:
Text Input is a simple input field.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/input/+page.md
code:
<label class="input">
  <svg class="h-[1em] opacity-50" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
    <g
      stroke-linejoin="round"
      stroke-linecap="round"
      stroke-width="2.5"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
    >
      <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle>
      <path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"></path>
    </g>
  </svg>
  <input type="search" required placeholder="Search" />
</label>
